claim: Reusable scenario authoring graphs can be exported and imported through a bounded checksummed open schema without copying unrelated project or AI state.
verified: Selected export automatically includes every required ancestor and canonicalizes scenarios by stable ID
The pack retains ordered turns, complete turn revision history, complete scenario edit history, lifecycle, lineage, timestamps, and author IDs
Votes, annotations, labels, responses, rerun results, policies, project files, settings, credentials, and transport state are excluded

Runtime decoding bounds bytes and nested collections, rejects unknown fields and future schemas, verifies current-turn projection and canonical history, recomputes SHA-256, and requires a closed acyclic graph
Import into a different project is one prevalidated Yjs transaction; exact duplicates are idempotent and any same-ID/different-content collision aborts all writes
The strict Draft 2020-12 public schema validates the committed CC0 sample and closes every object boundary to undeclared authority
Product controls disclose included and excluded data, validate and preview before explicit confirmation, and use no model or network
The exact public schema and a self-check command are discoverable through the headless syzygy_platform_contracts MCP tool
limitations: Researcher identities and timestamps are installation/caller supplied and are not authenticated or trusted across installations.
A structurally valid pack can contain deceptive or sensitive research text; schema validation does not establish truth or safety.
No authenticated signatures, revocation, malware scanning, destination policy, or redaction workflow is included.
No packaged OS Save/Open-dialog or external third-party reader interoperability run is included.
The format intentionally excludes votes, annotations, labels, model outputs, policies, and project state; it is not a full-project archive.
